test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As per census 2011, which among the following state had the highest population?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **Census 2011**, **West Bengal** was identified as the **fourth most populous state** in India, with a total population of approximately **91,276,115** (9.13 crore).
 
• Among the options provided, **West Bengal** holds the highest population figure, significantly exceeding **Tamil Nadu**, which recorded **72,147,030** inhabitants.
 
• **Rajasthan**, the largest state by area, had a population of **68,548,437**, placing it below the population count of **West Bengal** in the **2011 Census** records.
 
• **Karnataka** recorded a population of **61,095,297**, making it the state with the lowest population among the four given choices.
 
• **West Bengal** also exhibited a high **decadal growth rate** of **13.84 percent** between 2001 and 2011 and remains one of the most **densely populated** regions in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **2011 Census** was the **15th National Census** of India and the **7th after independence**, conducted under the slogan **Our Census, Our Future**.
 
• **Population Hierarchy** in 2011:
 
 
• **Uttar Pradesh**: Ranked first with a population of about **19.98 crore**.
 
• **Maharashtra**: Ranked second with **11.24 crore**.
 
• **Bihar**: Ranked third with **10.41 crore**.
 
• **West Bengal**: Ranked fourth with **9.13 crore**.
 
 
 
• **Demographic Facts**:
 
 
• **Highest Density**: **Bihar** had the highest population density with **1,106 persons per sq km**, followed by **West Bengal** with **1,028**.
 
• **Lowest Population**: **Sikkim** was the least populous state, while **Lakshadweep** was the least populous Union Territory.
 
• **Sex Ratio**: The overall sex ratio for India was **943 females per 1,000 males**.
